title: Migrate ioutil deprecated functions to os/io equivalents
description: A Go file utility uses deprecated ioutil functions (ioutil.ReadFile, ioutil.WriteFile, ioutil.TempFile, ioutil.NopCloser). Migrate each to its modern os/io equivalent.

task_spec.prompt:
Migrate fileutil.go away from the deprecated io/ioutil package.

Replace each deprecated call:
- `ioutil.ReadFile(path)` → `os.ReadFile(path)`
- `ioutil.WriteFile(path, data, 0644)` → `os.WriteFile(path, data, 0644)`
- `ioutil.TempFile(dir, pattern)` → `os.CreateTemp(dir, pattern)`
- `ioutil.NopCloser(r)` → `io.NopCloser(r)`

Update the import block: remove `io/ioutil`, keep `os`, add `io` for NopCloser.

Run `go test ./...` to verify all 3 tests pass.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to confirm no regressions from your refactor. Also review the code you changed — any remaining duplication, long functions, or unclear names to clean up?
Final pass: run `go test ./...` and confirm everything is green. Give me a one-line summary of what changed.
